items.source:
ReactiveChangeStreamOperation allows creation and execution of reactive MongoDB Change Stream operations in a fluent API style.
The starting domainType is used for mapping a potentially given TypedAggregation used for filtering. By default, the originating domainType is also used for mapping back the result from the Document. However, it is possible to define an different returnType via as.
The collection to operate on is optional in which case call collection with the actual database are watched, use watchCollection to define a fixed collection. 
    
        changeStream(Jedi.class)
            .watchCollection("star-wars")
            .filter(where("operationType").is("insert"))
            .resumeAt(Instant.now())
            .listen();
items.translation:
ReactiveChangeStreamOperation 允许以流式 API 风格创建和执行反应式的 MongoDB 变更流 (Change Stream) 操作。
起始的 domainType 用于映射可能提供的、用于过滤的 TypedAggregation。默认情况下，起始的 domainType 也用于将结果从 Document 映射回来。然而，可以通过 as 定义不同的 returnType。
要操作的目标集合是可选的；如果不指定，则调用 collection 以监听实际数据库，此时应使用 watchCollection 来定义固定的集合。 
    
        changeStream(Jedi.class)
            .watchCollection("star-wars")
            .filter(where("operationType").is("insert"))
            .resumeAt(Instant.now())
            .listen();

items.source:
Start creating a change stream operation for the given domainType watching all collections within the database.
Consider limiting events be defining a collection and/or filter.
items.translation:
为给定的 domainType 启动一个变更流操作，以监听数据库中的所有集合。
可以通过定义 collection 和/或 filter 来限制事件。

items.source: ReactiveChangeStreamOperation.ReactiveChangeStream provides methods for constructing change stream operations in a fluent way.
items.translation: ReactiveChangeStreamOperation.ReactiveChangeStream 提供了以流畅方式构建变更流操作的方法。

items.source: Provide a filter for limiting results (optional).
items.translation: 提供用于限制结果的过滤器（可选）。

items.source: Compose change stream execution by calling one of the terminating methods.
items.translation: 通过调用终止方法之一来执行变更流。
